6.7 Which variation points are affected by a particular FMFea-
ture?
Because a FMFeatureMap does not directly refer to VariationPoint elements, it
is not straightforward to see which variation points are affected by a particular feature.
First, we need to look at SwSystemconstantValueSet and PostBuildVari-
antCriterionValueSet to see which SwSystemconst and PostBuildVari-
antCriterion elements are actually affected by these. Figures 6.2 and 6.3 illustrate
this.

PostBuildVariantCriterion are referenced. Figure 6.4 shows the structure of a
variation point. While the PostBuildVariantCriterion is directly visible in Figure
6.4, a SwSystemconst would be referenced from a ConditionByFormula.
